unverified_private_results: Excluded deliberately; never put privately reported scores in this repository.

source_audit.organiser_status: User-supplied organiser webpage screenshots directly confirm seven girls teams (Dacorum, Gloucester, Newbury, Reigate & Banstead, St Albans, Woking, Wycombe), new Dacorum 1–5 Newbury official result, and corresponding 2026/27 girls league standings.
source_audit.other_results: Two earlier tracker results are not visible in the cropped screenshots (Newbury 6–0 Wycombe and Gloucester 3–4 St Albans) and still need direct source recheck. The four organiser-grid-confirmed results are Dacorum 3–1 Gloucester, Reigate & Banstead 4–1 Newbury, St Albans 2–2 Reigate & Banstead, and Dacorum 1–5 Newbury.
source_audit.discrepancy_resolution: Previous six-team roster statement arose from cached text extraction of organiser page; direct screenshot shows Wycombe as seventh girls-league team. Do not confuse the boys Southern Counties League table with the girls table.

model_audit.conclusion: Legacy V3 Newbury starting advantage was not sufficiently supported by 2025/26 league evidence. Removed legacy base ratings and recalibrated title estimates.
model_audit.sensitivity: The relative strength of the top teams is sensitive to the weight given to early-season matches, and only one of five existing scores has independent match-specific confirmation.
model_audit.validation: Newbury 5–1 Dacorum added as sixth result, standings reconstructed, 36 matches remaining, 100,000 Monte Carlo seasons, secondary seed sanity check; probabilities sum to 100%.
